title: [Bug] Claude Opus 4.5 ignores instructions, significant degradation since Jan 14
body:
**Bug Description**
Since 14 January, there has been a significant degradation in the performance of Claude Opus 4.5. Specifically, Claude Code appears to disregard all provided instructions, whereas Claude Sonnet 4.5 continues to function effectively. I have recorded a screencast documenting these issues as evidence: https://share.cleanshot.com/kvvM1hDN

**Environment Info**
- Platform: darwin
- Terminal: ghostty
- Version: 2.1.17
- Feedback ID: 2813710d-990a-4b94-9e4e-4838652b53f1

**Errors**
```json
[{"error":"Error: ENOENT: no such file or directory, scandir '/Library/Application Support/ClaudeCode/.claude/skills'\n    at readdirSync (unknown)\n    at <anonymous> (/$bunfs/root/claude:12:1903)\n    at vW (/$bunfs/root/claude:11:35097)\n    at readdirSync (/$bunfs/root/claude:12:1864)\n    at y2R (/$bunfs/root/claude:1479:380)\n    at y2R (/$bunfs/root/claude:1479:1350)\n    at <anonymous> (/$bunfs/root/claude:1479:4440)\n    at <anonymous> (/$bunfs/root/claude:1479:5171)\n    at A (/$bunfs/root/claude:11:7244)\n    at pX8 (/$bunfs/root/claude:4784:4342)","timestamp":"2026-01-23T11:08:00.720Z"}]
```
author: marvell

top_comments.author: marvell
top_comments.body:
Additional findings: the issue is specific to Opus 4.5 with the `"language": "Russian"` setting.

I've done more investigation and found that the problem occurs **only** with Claude Opus 4.5 when output language is set to Russian.

## Comparison tests with the same prompt

**Prompt (in Russian):** `проверь консистентность дизайна @src/components/pdf-preview/ с @src/components/file-list/ и @src/components/chat/` (check design consistency)

---

**Model: Opus 4.5 | Output lang: EN | Prompt in Russ

top_comments.author: micjohnson777
top_comments.body: Again, this issue is reporting Opus not Sonnet 4.5 issues. Claude continues to freeze, the Chat stops showing my comments, they disappear and I have to use ESC to get Claude back. It is ignoring instructions from the same project from the previous day. This issue ticket reports Opus.
